systems.system: Land registration system and land-holding database of the Land Administration Authority
systems.owner: Land Administration Authority, under the Minister responsible for land matters
systems.tiers: national; section 5(2)(a) charges the Authority with an accurate and complete database of land holding, registration of land transactions, leases, and deeds registry functions

note: Land statute (an excerpt, sections 1 to 17): land registration only, out of scope; nothing on civil registration.
